title: Grade 4 Mathematics — Place Value & Total Value
subject: Mathematics
canonical_assessment_engine: EXQ assessment_definitions → assessment_items → assessment_assignments → assessment_attempts → assessment_responses
release_gate: Do not publish unless the source authority and canonical outcome are verified, existing EXQ schema/permissions have been inspected, and a learner end-to-end test passes.

questions.prompt: In 4,582, which place does the digit 5 occupy?
questions.explanation: Count from the right: 2 ones, 8 tens, 5 hundreds, 4 thousands.

questions.prompt: What is the total value of the digit 7 in 7,304?
questions.explanation: The 7 occupies the thousands place, so 7 × 1,000 = 7,000.

questions.prompt: Which number has the digit 6 in the tens place?
questions.explanation: 3,462 has 2 ones and 6 tens. The tens digit is second from the right.

questions.prompt: A school has 12,450 exercise books. What is the total value of the digit 2?
questions.explanation: The 2 is in the thousands place, so its total value is 2,000.

questions.prompt: A learner says that the total value of the digit 3 in 13,625 is 300. What is the correct total value?
questions.explanation: The 3 is in the thousands place. Its total value is 3,000, not 300.
